nextGame.note: Sunday noon kickoff in the Superdome. Minnesota has won all four of its games.

news.headline: Alvin Kamara and Chris Olave are back at practice
news.summary: Both of them sat out Wednesday and both were back on Thursday on a limited basis. Receiver Barion Brown practiced again too, three days before the Vikings game.

news.headline: Tyler Shough practices with his hurt hand
news.summary: The quarterback took a full practice Thursday after being limited earlier in the week with a sore left hand. He is listed as hurt but he is working.

news.headline: Minnesota signs Odell Beckham Jr.
news.summary: The Vikings added the New Orleans native and former LSU receiver to their practice squad on Wednesday. He is not on their main roster, so they would have to move him up for him to play in the Superdome on Sunday.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff. It is homecoming at Florida.

news.headline: Sumrall says South Carolina has the most talent yet
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said South Carolina is the best group of players Florida has faced this year, even though the Gamecocks have lost three games. They come to Florida on Saturday for homecoming.

news.headline: Vernell Brown III might play Saturday
news.summary: Florida lists the receiver as questionable against South Carolina, a step up from doubtful last week. Coach Jon Sumrall said Brown is cleared to practice and heading the right way.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh apologizes to his coach
news.summary: The Florida running back sent coach Jon Sumrall a text message Sunday to say he was sorry for how he played in the 45-17 loss at Missouri. Baugh carried the ball 12 times for 13 yards in that game.

news.headline: Five LSU players are out for Kentucky
news.summary: Linebackers Whit Weeks and Charles Ross, tight end Trey'Dez Green, safety Dashawn Spears and receiver Phillip Wright are all hurt and will not play Saturday. Coach Lane Kiffin has said Green could be back sooner than people expected.

news.headline: Sam Leavitt says he will be ready on Saturday
news.summary: The LSU quarterback told reporters Tuesday that his sore hamstring feels really good and he will be 100 percent by Saturday. He played through it the last two games.

news.headline: Kentucky's stadium is sold out for LSU
news.summary: Kentucky said Tuesday that every ticket for Saturday's game is gone, and asked its fans to wear blue. Kickoff is 6:00 our time on ESPN.

nextGame.note: Saturday morning kickoff at West Point.

news.headline: Tulane has not named its quarterback for Army
news.summary: Coach Will Hall would not say this week whether Kadin Semonza or freshman Trace Johnson starts Saturday at West Point. Semonza has started the last three games.

news.headline: Jamauri McClure is back for the Army game
news.summary: McClure hurt his left foot in August and has not played all season. Tulane expects its best running back on the field Saturday at Army.

news.headline: Maurice Turner wins the conference weekly award
news.summary: Turner carried the ball 12 times for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Saturday's 24-21 win over Southern Miss, including the 74-yard run that put Tulane ahead. It is the first weekly honor of his career.
